item.title: New Green Card rules from September: Categories affected and those exempt
item.description: Beginning in September 2026, the USCIS unveiled new regulations affecting Green Card seekers. These guidelines emphasize the financial self-sufficiency of applicants while excluding those in humanitarian categories. Nearly all applicants, including family and various occupational groups, must satisfy these criteria. While the Form I-864, Affidavit of Support, is crucial, it cannot guarantee approval on its own.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Thierry Henry lists combined SoHo penthouse for $25 million after 2026 renovation
item.description: Former footballer Thierry Henry has listed his SoHo penthouse in New York for $25 million. Henry bought the penthouse and the unit below for $14.85 million in 2010 and combined them into a roughly 6,000-square-foot home. He and his partner Andrea Rajacic renovated the property several times, including again in 2026.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: 'Didn't collect ID': Guwahati homestay where student, ‘lover’ stayed 5 times sealed
item.description: Nimisha Thakuria's death has prompted police to seal Rudra’s Kitchen homestay at Dharapur. Investigators are examining guest documentation and prior visits made by her and Ashiq Ali. Police indicated that Ali's claim of suicide has not yet been confirmed. The circumstances surrounding Nimisha's unconscious state and subsequent death are being explored. Authorities are investigating all possible angles related to the case.
item.dc:creator: TATHAGATA BHATTACHARJEE

item.title: 'We trusted EC in 2017': Akhilesh alleges poll officials deleted SP votes in 2022
item.description: Akhilesh Yadav has accused the Election Commission of deliberately deleting votes belonging to the Samajwadi Party. He argues that this malpractice has been ongoing for years but is only now gaining attention. In his statement, he noted that voters from the 2019 elections were unjustly denied the opportunity to vote in 2022. This controversy follows recent revelations about objections within the Election Commission regarding the electoral rolls revision.
item.dc:creator: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: Florida used robot rabbits to hunt Burmese pythons threatening the Everglades
item.description: Florida is testing solar-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons in the Everglades. Developed by the South Florida Water Management District and University of Florida, the robotic decoys mimic prey using heat and scent while AI cameras detect approaching snakes. Officials can then alert trained removal agents, adding technology to Florida’s wider python control efforts.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Belgian trekker says India legal battle kept him from dying mother
item.description: Peter Van Geit, a Belgian trekker and activist, faced protracted legal battles following a heart-wrenching trekking accident that distanced him from his ailing mother. After receiving court approval to visit her, he finally said goodbye just before her passing. Although the Supreme Court has dismissed the criminal charges against him, citing no wrongdoing, the emotional toll of his mother's death and the precious time lost lingers heavily on his heart.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: New mobile recharge rules: 30-day plans, call-only options and more
item.description: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India has unveiled enhancements to prepaid mobile recharge options, featuring more voice-and-SMS-only Special Tariff Vouchers. Users can now access plans with a validity of 30 days or less. This initiative is especially beneficial for senior citizens and budget-conscious individuals who prefer voice-only prepaid plans without data, addressing concerns raised by Rajya Sabha MP Raghav Chadha.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: 'Marriage doesn't advance age': HC rejects Muslim personal law defence in POCSO case
item.description: The Delhi High Court has taken a firm stance by ruling against a man who married a 16-year-old under Muslim personal law, emphasizing that this does not exempt him from POCSO charges concerning sexual activity. While the girl asserted her consent, the court reiterated the importance of legal safeguards for minors. Attempts to contest the FIR based on her claims were rejected, underscoring the inviolability of child protection laws.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: UP double murder: Retired Army man, 1st wife found dead in pool of blood
item.description: In a tragic event, retired Army veteran Shamsuddin and his wife Saddo Begum were discovered murdered in their residence, the police alerted by neighbors. Their bodies were located amidst a pool of blood, prompting forensic experts and a dog squad to join the inquiry. With the motive still unknown, multiple investigation teams are being formed.
item.dc:creator: PRACHI KUMAWAT

item.title: Sibal escalates SIR row, demands CEC’s removal and review of elections
item.description: Kapil Sibal has raised concerns over the Election Commission's decision-making under Gyanesh Kumar during a ten-month period. His allegations include that decisions were made unilaterally, bypassing other commissioners and statutory protocols. Sibal has called for an investigation into the electoral rolls and recent elections conducted in Bihar and West Bengal. In response, the Election Commission acknowledged concerns and proposed several corrective measures to address them.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Korea's KF-21 is flying, AMCA still on paper: The fighter-jet race India cannot afford to lose
item.description: As South Korea's KF-21 program progresses towards operational capability, India's AMCA program is still finalizing construction partners. The KF-21 has completed extensive testing and received certification, with production already underway. In contrast, India's bid process for an AMCA partner has faced multiple delays, slowing prototype development. The Indian Air Force currently operates below its authorized fighter strength, increasing operational challenges.
item.dc:creator: DHRUV YADAV

item.title: Heathrow expansion faces fresh hurdle as UK PM withholds third runway backing
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has voiced significant concerns regarding the proposed third runway at Heathrow Airport. He pointed out the necessity of addressing the long-standing worries of local residents. The expansion's timeline could stretch by four years, with operations potentially starting in 2039. Heathrow's struggle with capacity issues sharply contrasts with other major European airports, fueling an ongoing debate centered on community impact and infrastructure demands.
item.dc:creator: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: Three matches in 24 hours! PV Sindhu criticises badminton schedule at Asian Games
item.description: PV Sindhu played twice on Saturday, with her third-round match finishing after midnight. She was back on court on Sunday afternoon for her quarterfinal against China's Chen Yufei, which she lost.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: From warship to AIR 2: How IAF doctor cracked NEET PG 2026
item.description: Sqn Ldr Pallakshi Prasad, a medical officer in the Armed Forces, secured All India Rank 2 in NEET PG 2026. She graduated from the Armed Forces Medical College with commendable academic records and personal dedication. Pallakshi balanced her military duties and rigorous studies to achieve this milestone. Supported by her family, she followed her dream of becoming a doctor against their engineering backgrounds.
item.dc:creator: ARVIND CHAUHAN

item.title: 2.5% deposit, £600,000 price cap: How UK's new home-buying scheme will work
item.description: The UK government plans to launch a new scheme called 'Your First Home' to assist first-time buyers. This initiative allows qualifying individuals to acquire new-build properties with a minimal deposit of 2.5 percent. Eligible buyers will also receive a government equity loan for up to 20 percent of the property's value to ease financial burdens. The scheme is intended to stimulate demand for new housing and support the construction sector.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Market mood check: Crude, US-Iran talks and economic data to drive Dalal Street this week
item.description: This week on Dalal Street sees a shortened holiday schedule as geopolitical concerns and volatile oil prices loom large. Analysts believe negotiations between the US and Iran might sway both oil costs and the rupee's value. Investors are on high alert for shifts in global bond yields that impact emerging markets, while key domestic metrics like industrial production and auto sales are set to provide essential economic insights.

item.title: 'Gaza on verge of exploding': Egypt spy chief warned Israel before Oct 7
item.description: Egypt’s intelligence chief Abbas Kamel visited Israel on September 26, warning officials about impending Hamas aggression. He urged Israel to make economic concessions to prevent escalation, signaling a dangerous situation in Gaza. Despite his warnings, Israeli officials reportedly did not take specific action in response. Numerous warnings continued to emerge from Egypt and other nations leading up to the October 7 attack.
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: Amit Shah flags off India's first LNG train, launches Rs 1,542 crore railway projects
item.description: Amit Shah inaugurated India's first LNG-powered train and several railway projects valued at over Rs 1,542 crore. The LNG-powered train utilizes a dual-fuel system, helping to significantly reduce diesel consumption. Shah also laid the foundation for the indigenous Kavach automatic train protection system, targeting enhanced railway safety. Additionally, the Sabarmati-Sarkhej railway line doubling project aims to improve connectivity and facilitate industrial growth.
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: October 2026: 70,000 rural youth set for placement-linked training under DDU-GKY 2.0
item.description: Around 70,000 rural youth across 24 States and Union Territories are expected to begin skill training under DDU-GKY 2.0 from October 2026. The Ministry of Rural Development said 2,015 batches are planned, with training linked to employment opportunities. The scheme covers courses lasting three to 12 months, aligned with the National Skill Qualification Framework. States must complete target allocations to implementing agencies by October 31, 2026, as the Centre accelerates the rollout.
item.dc:creator: TOI Education

item.title: ‘Ma, they punched me’: Student’s last call to family; how horror unfolded at homestay
item.description: Nimisha Thakuria, a 22-year-old Gauhati University student, made a frantic phone call stating she could not breathe. After her family lost contact, she was found critically injured at a homestay on the outskirts of Guwahati. Her alleged companion, Ashiq Ali, has been detained, stating that she hanged herself. Local residents have protested for a thorough investigation, linking the incident to broader societal issues.
item.dc:creator: TATHAGATA BHATTACHARJEE
